Every page of the V3 docs, with the V4 package or API that replaces it. 187 rows: 115 mapped, 24 partial, 48 not applicable, 0 unknown.

- **Mapped**: V4 has the same capability.
- **Partial**: V4 covers it differently or only in part; read the note.
- **Not applicable**: store, deployment or third-party guidance with no Despia API to move.
- **Unknown**: no V4 equivalent found yet. Ask support before you migrate that feature.

Old `despia('scheme://...')` calls keep running through the `Legacy` package while you move; see [V3 web app to V4](/convert/from-v3-web-app). The same table is served as JSON at [/migrate-map.json](/migrate-map.json).

| Age Assurance | Mapped | `Core/AgeAssurance` | `dsx.module.ageassurance.check() / resolve() / last() / forget()` | Same verbs as v3 ageassurance://; no Legacy row for the old spelling. |
| Sandbox | Partial | `Core/DevSettings` | `dsx.module.dev.set() / reset() (shake-to-open dev panel)` | DevSettings switches a test install to a staging origin and back; no Legacy row for sandbox://set\|clear or window.isSandbox. |
